sloka: लोके च मामिका ।एकैकस्योपकारस्य प्राणान्दास्यामि ते कपे ।नरः प्रत्युपकाराणामापस्त्वायाति पात्रताम् ।। ७.४०.२२ ॥
transliteration: loke ca māmikā ।ekaikasyopakārasya prāṇāndāsyāmi te kape ।naraḥ pratyupakārāṇāmāpastvāyāti pātratām ।। 7.40.22 ॥

translations.english: Rama declares that his gratitude is such that he would give his life for each of Hanuman's favors, emphasizing that a person becomes worthy of receiving return favors even when in distress.
